3.  The present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the CrPC seeks following prayers:-
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to issue a writ of Certiorari or any Writ, Order or direction of like nature thereby quashing the notice dated 24.03.2024 bearing no. LCB/ Investigation/
Report/ 484/ 2024 issued by the concerned Investigating Officer of P. S. Local Crime Branch, Vadodara Rural, Vadodara, Gujrat against the Petitioner in FIR No.
11197054230939 Under Section 406, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120 (B)/ 114 IPC in the interest and furtherance of justice.
Any other order or relief which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper be pleased to pass in favor of the Petitioner, in the interest and furtherance of justice."

Reliance has been placed on a judgment of Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Jamshed Adil Khan & Anr. v. Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir and Anr., 2022:DHC:2594.
